title: Two blocks, 10 N on the bottom one: they move together
about: together a = F/(m1+m2) = 2; the top needs f = 2 kg x 2 = 4 N <= μN = 7.84 N: it sticks

lines.say: Imagine two blocks, one on top of the other, on the floor.
The top block is 2 kg and the bottom block is 3 kg.
We apply 10 newtons on the bottom block.
The coefficient of friction between the blocks is 0.4.

notes: the top block sticks to the block below
